name: H3 drift control: schedule-matched prefix noise
plain: A chained H3 segment normally keeps its carried video prefix fully clean, which the author measured as building up contrast and texture error along a chain. This changes the denoise mask each step so that the prefix takes a small, schedule-matched amount of the sampler's noise, fading to exact at the seam. The same mask must also reach the model, or it would label noisy tokens as clean.
math:
ratio = clamp(σ_next/σ, 0, 1), σ_next = next lower sigma in the schedule.
weights over prefix latent steps: 1 for the older ones, then (taper−i−1)/taper down to 0 at the seam.
mask[prefix t] = ratio·weight(t). H3 video mask = ⌈mask·256⌉/256, passed to apply_model. Audio untouched here.

props.distribution: the sampler's own (via the mask mix)
